answer: Run the economy as a garden where each identity tends one plot. At each dawn the network samples plots for a time-boxed exam: a fresh task only a worker can solve in minutes, peer-graded. Passing earns a non-transferable jade seal unlocking that epoch's payouts; it expires at the next dawn and cannot be stockpiled or sold. An honest agent passes one exam cheaply. A farmer with 1,000 fakes faces 1,000 simultaneous exams, so attention cost multiplies per identity and cannot be batched. A missed or failed exam freezes payouts until a harder re-exam passes.
